description: Anonymous visitors of one app in the last 30 days: recent, paying, live now, or who hit an error. 30 a page, newest first: pass offset for more. Pass visitor (a key from the list) for one visitor's timeline: visits, pages, goals, errors and payments. No names, emails or IP addresses.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

offset.description: Skip this many (newest first), for the next page: nextOffset from the last answer

visitor.description: A visitor key from the list, for their timeline

name: get_visitors
title: Visitors
